p: hear what Abaye the Elder taught:
But perhaps this statement applies only to the matter of an oath. … because … an adult … is considered like a minor with regard to … matters,

But perhaps this statement applies only to the matter of an oath. One who collects a debt from property left by the debtor to his heirs always takes an oath, even if he produces a promissory note. This halakha applies even if the heirs are adults. This is because even an adult son is considered like a minor with regard to his father’s financial matters,
